results.title: India's New Drone Hunter Fires 64 Missiles In 10 Seconds, Challenges Pakistan's Swarm Strategy
results.description: Drone warfare has changed the battlefield forever. From Ukraine to West Asia and Operation Sindoor, low-cost drone swarms have exposed the limitations of traditional air-defence systems. India is now preparing its own answer—Bhargavastra. The indigenous vehicle-mounted system combines radar, electro-optical sensors, passive RF detection and a launcher carrying 64 micro-missiles and rockets capable of engaging multiple drones in rapid succession. Unlike electronic jamming systems, Bhargavastra is a hard-kill solution designed to physically destroy incoming threats. With internal trials expected to conclude within months, the system is moving closer to user evaluation by the armed forces. This video explains the technology, the significance of the recent Army demonstration, the role Bhargavastra could play in Mission Sudarshan Chakra, and why India's defence strategy is rapidly shifting towards defeating autonomous warfare
